title: 功能句
goal: 能区分七类邮件功能，并用相应句型完成交际动作。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 为每条要求选择对应的功能句
正确使用功能句的句型

sources.title: ETS：Writing Scoring Guide — Write an Email
sources.used: 0–5 分每一档的描述（本课是中文转述，原文以官方为准）

body.p: 功能句把题目的每条要求变成一个具体的动作。说明情况是陈述事实，道歉是承认造成的不便，询问是要信息，请求是要对方做事。判断功能看整句的意思，不看有没有 please 或 thank you。

body.box: The access code has expired. / Could you tell me when it expires? / Could you issue a new code?

body.p: 三句分别是说明情况、询问期限和请求换新。后两句都是 Could you 问句，功能要看动词和宾语。一句话可以有两个功能，每个功能都要有具体内容。

cards.title: 常用表达：基本句型
rows: 说明情况
report + 名词，写出具体是什么情况。
I am writing to report a missing page in the manual.
道歉
apologize for + 名词或动名词。
I apologize for attaching the wrong file.
询问信息
Could you tell me + 疑问词从句，从句用陈述语序。
Could you tell me when the desk closes?
提出建议
suggest 后面接动名词，不接 to do。
I suggest adding a short description to each item.
提出请求
Could you + 动词原形，写明要对方做的事。
Could you replace the missing page?
表示感谢
Thank you for + 名词或动名词。
Thank you for checking the attachment.
发出邀请
Would you like to + 动词原形，写明请对方参加什么。
Would you like to join our planning meeting?

cards.title: 常用表达：句型变化
rows: 说明情况
There is + 单数名词，写明在哪里。
There is a duplicate entry in the attendance list.
道歉
I am sorry that + 完整从句。
I am sorry that my late arrival delayed the interview.
询问信息
I would like to know whether + 陈述语序。
I would like to know whether the fee includes materials.
提出建议
recommend that + 主语 + 动词原形。
I recommend that we test the microphone beforehand.
提出请求
Would it be possible to + 动词原形。
Would it be possible to extend the loan?
表示感谢
appreciate + 名词。不说 appreciate you for。
I appreciate your explanation of the procedure.
发出邀请
invite + 人 + to do，受邀的人要写出来。
We would like to invite you to lead the demonstration.

cards.title: 常用表达：内容限定
rows: 说明情况
主语 + have not yet + 过去分词，表示到现在还没有。
I have not yet received the revised timetable.
道歉
Please accept my apologies for + 名词。
Please accept my apologies for the delay in returning the key.
询问信息
疑问词 + be + 主语。直接问句要倒装。
What is the deadline for submitting the form?
提出建议
One option would be to + 动词原形，提出一个可选的办法。
One option would be to distribute printed instructions.
提出请求
I would be grateful if + 主语 + could do。
I would be grateful if you could reserve a seat near the entrance.
表示感谢
Thank you for + 对方做的具体的事。感谢不能代替请求。
Thank you for arranging an accessible entrance.
发出邀请
We hope + 主语 + can join，表示邀请，对方还没有答应。
We hope you can join us for the opening session.

body.box:
Task: A campus printing office has sent the wrong size of labels. Write to apologize for an unclear order, suggest a solution, and ask whether a new batch can be ready on Wednesday.

Dear Printing Team,
I apologize for leaving the label dimensions out of my order. One option would be to trim the existing sheets to the required size. Could you tell me whether a corrected batch could be ready on Wednesday?
Best regards,
Anya

body.p: I apologize for leaving 是道歉，One option would be to trim 是建议，Could you tell me whether 是询问信息。末句问的是周三能否准备好，不是要求重印。

body.box:
I apologize for leaving the dimensions out.
I suggest trimming the sheets.
Could you tell me whether the batch is ready?

body.p: for 后面接 leaving，suggest 后面接 trimming。whether 后面用陈述语序 the batch is ready，不用 is the batch ready。

groups.text:
Task: A campus theater has returned a borrowed prop late. The writer must apologize for the delay.
Draft: Dear Props Officer, The prop was returned on Tuesday instead of Monday. ___ Best regards, Tessa

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Could you tell me whether the prop arrived on Tuesday?
I am sorry that returning it late disrupted the schedule.
I suggest returning the next prop on Monday.
Thank you for allowing the prop to be returned on Tuesday.
items.why: apologize for the delay 要求道歉，第二项承认迟还造成了不便。第四项是感谢，不是道歉。

groups.text:
Task: A catalog editor asks for a suggestion about entries with missing dates.
Draft: Dear Editor, Several entries have no dates. ___ Best regards, Anton

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Could you tell me which entries have no dates?
I apologize for leaving the dates out of the entries.
We could check the original records for the missing dates.
Thank you for checking the dates in the catalog.
items.why: a suggestion 要求提出办法。第三项提出查原始记录，是可以执行的办法。

groups.text:
Task: Invite a student historian to introduce a collection of old campus maps.
Draft: Dear Dana, The map display opens on Friday. ___ Best regards, Ellis

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Thank you for introducing the maps at Friday's display.
I suggest that the maps be displayed in date order.
Could you explain whether the maps are dated accurately?
Would you like to give the introduction at the opening?
items.why: Invite 要求发出邀请，第四项问对方是否愿意在开幕时做介绍。第一项是感谢，把介绍写成了已经做完的事。

groups.text:
Task: Thank a staff member for resolving a conflict between two room allocations.
Draft: Dear Allocation Officer, Both groups now have suitable rooms. ___ Best regards, Kai

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: I appreciate your help in resolving the room conflict.
Could you tell me whether both rooms are available?
I apologize for allocating both rooms to one group.
I suggest checking the two room assignments again.
items.why: Thank 对应 I appreciate your help，resolving the room conflict 写明感谢的是什么，即第一项。

items.stem: The writer accepts responsibility for an incorrect seat number.
items.why: apologize for 后面接动名词 giving。the wrong seat number 是完整的名词短语。

items.stem: The sender needs information about an application deadline.
items.why: 间接问句 when the application period ends 使用陈述语序，不能加 does。

items.stem: The team needs a suggestion about a difficult checklist.
items.why: suggest 后面接 adding。an example to each instruction 写明加什么、加在哪里。

items.stem: The writer invites an archivist to introduce a document collection.
items.why: invite you to introduce 为邀请句型，to 后接动词原形。

groups.text:
Task: Ask the animal-care coordinator for information about training before helping at the campus shelter.
Draft: Dear Coordinator, I would like to help with the rabbits next term. I have not attended the handling course. ___ Best regards, Aki

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Could you tell me which training I must complete first?
Could you enroll me in next term's rabbit-handling course?
Thank you for enrolling me in the required handling course.
I recommend adding another rabbit-handling course next term.
items.why: Ask … for information 要求询问信息，第一项问要先完成哪项培训。第二项直接要求报名，是请求，不是询问。

groups.text:
Task: Explain a problem with the campus legal clinic's appointment calendar, then suggest a solution.
Draft: Dear Clinic Administrator, Cancelled appointments still appear as booked. ___ Best regards, Pavel

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: I apologize for cancelling an appointment that was booked.
One option would be to remove cancelled bookings each evening.
Could you tell me why cancelled appointments remain visible?
Thank you for confirming that the appointment is still booked.
items.why: suggest a solution 要求提出办法，第二项提出每晚删除已取消的预约。第三项是询问原因，没有提出办法。

groups.text:
Task: Ask the safety office to send a replacement for an unreadable evacuation diagram.
Draft: Dear Safety Team, The diagram beside our laboratory door is badly faded. ___ Best regards, Tess

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Could you tell me when the original diagram was printed?
I suggest checking whether diagrams fade near laboratory doors.
Could you provide another copy of the evacuation plan?
Thank you for describing the laboratory's evacuation route.
items.why: Ask … to send a replacement 要求对方提供新图，第三项 provide another copy 正是这个请求。

groups.text:
Task: Explain a problem with the captions in a recorded language interview.
Draft: Dear Captioning Team, I checked the recording against its transcript. ___ Best regards, Luc

items.stem: Which sentence completes the task specified for this email?
options: Could you correct the captions using the interview transcript?
Thank you for aligning the captions with the interview audio.
I suggest comparing each caption with the relevant transcript line.
The captions display the previous speaker's words during each reply.
items.why: Explain a problem 要求说明问题。第四项指出字幕显示的是上一位说话人的话。第一项是请求，不是说明问题。

items.stem: The sender regrets missing a preparation session.
items.why: I am sorry that 后面接完整的从句 my absence delayed the preparations。for 不能引导从句。

items.stem: A mentor has explained a difficult selection procedure.
items.why: Thank you for 后面接 explaining，写明感谢对方做了什么。

items.stem: The organizing team invites a specialist to demonstrate a technique.
items.why: invite you to demonstrate 写出了受邀的人和要做的事。句型是 invite someone to do，不用 demonstrating。

items.stem: The writer asks whether materials are included in a seminar fee.
items.why: whether the fee includes 使用陈述语序，不增加 does。
